macro.ten_year_note: CNBC reported the 10-year Treasury yield fell by more than 3 basis points on the completed session.
macro.buyback_fact: Treasury announced on 19 Aug that long-end liquidity-support buyback operation maximums will rise from US$2bn to at least US$4bn per operation from 9 Sep.
macro.sanctions_fact: Treasury launched Operation Economic Outcast on 24 Aug, including sectoral determinations covering digital assets, technology, gold, aviation and shipping.

drivers.fact: Reuters reported chip stocks sold off: NVIDIA -2.9%, Micron -5.8% and Broadcom -2.6%; the SOX index declined.
drivers.boundary: The reporting supports a technology-led drag, not a proof that one policy headline independently caused every move.

drivers.fact: The 10-year yield fell to about 4.70% while investors assessed Treasury buyback discussion and Iran-related policy developments.
drivers.boundary: The official buyback expansion is scheduled for 9 Sep; a near-US$1tn TGA funding claim is not an announced allocation.

drivers.fact: NVIDIA is scheduled to report FY27 Q2 on 26 Aug at 14:00 PT; the result was not available at this report cutoff.
drivers.boundary: The earnings event is a validation point, not a pre-known result.
